categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in three segments: household appliance components, new energy (including equipment manufacturing, automotive components, and lithium battery materials), and optical communication materials. It is the largest domestic manufacturer of air conditioning auxiliary electric heaters, a top-two domestic producer of PTC electric heaters for new energy vehicles, and the sole domestic mass producer of pre-plated nickel materials for power batteries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company focuses on high-performance electric heaters and control systems, employing advanced electric heating technologies including PTC heaters, pre-plated nickel technology, and high-efficiency electric heating equipment for polysilicon production. It pursues a 'produce one, develop one, reserve one' R&D strategy, integrating independent innovation, industry-academia cooperation, and product introduction. Manufacturing emphasizes lean and digital production to improve efficiency and quality.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading household appliance brands such as Gree, Midea, Haier, and Roborock; major new energy vehicle manufacturers like BYD, JAC, Leapmotor, and XPeng; polysilicon producers including Tongwei and GCL; and optical communication companies such as FiberHome, Hengtong, and Yangtze Optical. The company serves mature markets like household appliances and optical communications, and growth markets including new energy vehicles and lithium batteries.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with significant presence in East China, North China, South China, Central China, Southwest China, and Northwest China. It has established subsidiaries and service teams in Shanghai, Zhuhai, Wuhan, Zhengzhou, Hefei, Qingdao, Chongqing, Handan, and Ma'anshan. It also actively develops overseas markets including Japan, Oman, Sweden, Turkey, and Abu Dhabi, and has contacts with global appliance leaders like LG and Samsung.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the electric heating and new energy supply chains. It manufactures core components such as electric heaters and pre-plated nickel materials, supplying directly to OEMs in household appliances, new energy vehicles, lithium battery manufacturers, and optical communication cable producers. It also engages in upstream R&D and production of specialized materials and equipment.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding overseas markets, enhancing new energy equipment sales and collections, developing new energy storage and aerospace markets, and increasing production capacity for new energy vehicle PTC heaters and pre-plated nickel materials. R&D focuses on new product development such as integrated washing and drying PTC heaters, high-temperature resistant PTC heaters, high-voltage molten salt heaters, and advanced heat exchangers. The company emphasizes innovation in materials, processes, and intelligent thermal management systems.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of manufactured products including electric heaters, new energy equipment, automotive components, lithium battery materials, and optical communication materials. The company signs long-term cooperation agreements with key customers and participates in bidding for orders. All sales are conducted via direct sales channels.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player and technology leader in electric heating for household appliances and new energy vehicles. It holds the largest market share in air conditioning auxiliary heaters and ranks top two in new energy vehicle PTC heaters in China. It is the only domestic mass producer of pre-plated nickel materials for power batteries, positioning itself as a pioneer in domestic substitution of imported materials. Competitors include other domestic and international electric heating and new energy component manufacturers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 3.71 billion, a 9.62% decrease year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 318 million, down 50.62%. Despite profit declines mainly due to asset disposal losses and reduced polysilicon industry investment, the company maintains stable operations with growth in new energy vehicle components (73.38% revenue growth) and lithium battery materials (70.61% growth). Total assets stood at RMB 6.69 billion with net assets of RMB 4.12 billion, showing a stable financial scale.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes advanced electric heating technology, comprehensive product variety, and high-quality service. It offers unique products such as the only domestically mass-produced pre-plated nickel materials for lithium batteries and high-performance PTC heaters with superior durability and efficiency. Its value proposition includes strong R&D capabilities, close customer relationships with industry leaders, and a full-service model providing localized, responsive support. The company also focuses on innovation to meet emerging market needs in new energy and intelligent thermal management.
